snippet.title: The Astra Protocol Teaser Gameplay
snippet.description:
Attention Captains,

We've released a teaser demo for The Astra Protocol.

Here's a few minutes of it in action, but you don't need to watch our footage, you can get your hands on it right now!

https://slicebar.itch.io/the-astra-protocol

How long can you last? How many asteroids can you destroy? What do you think? Let us know in the comments below
